as_told.title: Donna Hare: NASA scrubbing UAP photos

plain: Donna Hare is a woman who says that in the 1970s, while working at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston, she was shown a photo in a place called Building 8 and asked, "Is this a UFO?" She says the man just smiled and answered, "I can't tell you that," and podcast host Jesse Michels says she described UFOs being airbrushed out of images stored there, a story she told through the Disclosure Project, a group led by a man named Steven Greer that brought whistleblowers forward. Michels adds that this is why a man named Gary McKinnon later went looking for that building, and if it were true it would mean NASA was hiding UFOs from its own pictures.
